display_title: The Managing Director is Short of One Night
description:
**Original Novel:**    
[Chapters](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10998051), [Volumes](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=12804209) 

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846875), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13640209)

Her boyfriend cheated on her—with a junior he cherished. And she was even pregnant… On top of that, Noh Haewon is suddenly diagnosed with only one year left to live. Determined to live the rest of her life like a femme fatale, she creates a bucket list. Her boss, Kang Taekyung, who has long harbored feelings for her, happens to see that list. To fulfill the item that reads “Get married,” he proposes a contract marriage…
